articles.summary: MIDLAND, Texas, Jan. 07, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Viper Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: VNOM) (“Viper”), a subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, Inc. (NASDAQ: FANG) (“Diamondback”), today announced that it plans to release fourth quarter 2025 financial results on February 23, 2026 after the market closes.
articles.title: Viper Energy, Inc., a Subsidiary of Diamondback Energy, Inc., Schedules Fourth Quarter 2025 Conference Call for February 24, 2026
